title: 第25章 默契第26章 分赃
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
第二天一早，罗恩带着人出发了。
还是那四十多号人，还是布套蒙面。
领头的还是劳恩，罗恩混在人群里，穿着最普通的衣服，带着他的九筒。
劳恩骑在马上，回头看了一眼罗恩。罗恩点点头，劳恩一挥手，队伍往东边摸去。
与此同时，石溪岭另一边，另一伙马匪也出发了。
领头的是洛克，鲍里斯的护卫队长。鲍里斯自己混在人群里，穿着一身旧皮甲，脸上蒙着黑布。
鲍里斯已经把石溪领摸清楚了，决定今天动手。
罗恩能假扮马匪，他凭什么不能？
彼得那小子手里还有不少好东西，与其让罗恩一个人吃独食，不如自己也捞一把。
至于嫁祸给罗恩？顺手的事！
罗恩的人先到。
一个农庄，已经抢过一遍，应该还能搜刮出来一点破烂，但罗恩此行的目的主要是破坏。
劳恩一挥手，众人冲进去，挑挑拣拣，最后把房子点了。
黑烟刚升起来，远处忽然传来马蹄声。
罗恩抬头一看，另一伙马匪，五十多人，正往这边来。
两伙人隔着几百步，都停了下来。
劳恩握紧剑柄，低声问：“大人，打不打？”
罗恩没说话，盯着那伙人看。
对面领头的是个壮实汉子，骑在马上，也在往这边看。他身后的人群里，有一个人的身形……有点眼熟。
罗恩眯起眼。

那人也盯着这边看。
两拨人对视了几息，忽然都明白了。
鲍里斯！罗恩！
罗恩嘴角扯了一下。
有意思。
双方都围成一团，看样子是在商议。
罗恩这边讨论结束后。
示意劳恩策马上前几步，对面领头的也上前几步。两人隔着五十步，谁也不说话。
半晌，劳恩先开口，压着嗓子：“兄弟哪路的？”
对面那人笑了一声，也压着嗓子：“路过。想捞点。”
劳恩点点头：“巧了，我也是。”
两人又对视了一会儿。
“要不搞把大的？”
对面忽然道：“一个人吃不下。”
劳恩点头：“我知道。”
对面看着他：“一起？”
劳恩沉默了两秒，点点头：“一起！”
两人各自回头，招呼自己的人。两伙人相隔着几十步距离。近一百号人，四个高阶骑士扈从。
目标只有一个——彼得庄园。
content_en:
Early the next morning, Ron set out with his people.
The same number of over 40 people were still wearing cloth covers.
The leader was still Ron. Ron was mixed in the crowd, wearing the most ordinary clothes and carrying his nine tubes.
Ron sat on the horse and looked back at Ron. Ron nodded, and with a wave of his hand, the team headed east.
At the same time, on the other side of Shixi Ridge, another group of horse bandits also set off.
The leader is Locke, Boris's guard captain. Boris himself blended in with the crowd, wearing an old leather armor and a black cloth covering his face.
Boris has figured out the Stone Creek Territory clearly and decided to take action today.
Ron can pretend to be a horse bandit, why can't he?
Peter still has a lot of good stuff in his hands. Instead of letting Ron eat alone, he might as well get some for himself.
As for blaming Ron? Easy thing!
Ron's people arrived first.
A farm has been robbed, and some rags should still be recovered, but the main purpose of Ron's trip is destruction.
Lawn waved his hand, and everyone rushed in, picked and picked, and finally lit up the house.
Just as the black smoke rose, the sound of horse hooves suddenly came from the distance.
Ron looked up and saw another group of horse bandits, more than fifty people, coming this way.
Several hundred steps apart, the two groups stopped.
Lawn tightened his grip on the hilt of the sword and asked in a low voice: "Sir, do you want to fight?"
Ron said nothing and stared at the group.
The leader on the opposite side is a strong man, riding on a horse, also looking this way. In the crowd behind him, there was a figure... who looked a bit familiar.
Ron narrowed his eyes.
The man was also staring here.
The two groups of people looked at each other for a few seconds, and suddenly they all understood.
Boris! Ron!
Ron's mouth twitched.
interesting.
Both parties gathered around and seemed to be discussing.
After Ron's discussion ended.
He signaled Lauente to take a few steps forward immediately, and the leader on the opposite side also took a few steps forward. They were fifty steps apart and neither of them spoke.
After a while, Lao En spoke first, lowering his voice: "Where are you from, brother?"
The man opposite laughed and lowered his voice: "Passing by. I want to make some money."
Lawn nodded: "What a coincidence, so do I."
The two stared at each other for a while.
"How about something big?"
The person on the other side suddenly said: "I can't eat it alone."
Lawn nodded: "I know."
Looking at him from the other side: "Together?"
Lawn was silent for two seconds and nodded: "Together!"
The two of them each turned around and greeted their own people. The two groups were separated by dozens of steps. Nearly a hundred people, four high-level knights' retinues.
There is only one goal - Peter Manor.
